text: {"lessons":["My account value has fluctuated despite several periods without trades; short-term moves alone are not a reason to act when prices are unpredictable.","I should judge each position by its role and risk in the whole portfolio, not by whether it is above or below my purchase price; realized gains feel good, but that feeling is not a strategy.","Before buying or selling, I should check that the trade fits a consistent plan and my cash and risk limits, rather than reacting to regret, loss aversion, or recent price changes."]}
